stemMarkdown: A can do a piece of work in 12 days. A and B working together finish it in 6 days. How many days would B alone take? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Together they do $\dfrac{1}{6}$ of the work per day and A alone does $\dfrac{1}{12}$, so B's daily rate is $\dfrac{1}{6} - \dfrac{1}{12} = 0.083333$. B alone needs $12.0$ days.
